info.title: Agritech.Net CLI 1.0.0 — The Ultimate Open-Source Agriculture Technology Framework for .NET
info.description: Agritech.Net command-line tool: crop suitability, soil & fertilizer, ET0, weather, NDVI, drone missions, crop simulation, LoRaWAN decoding and the AI farm agent. Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
